Messages.Author: ShanDow
Messages.Body:
The old site used to have a downloads section if I remember correctly, I'm pretty sure I once downloaded a card list ( can't remember if it was PDF or CSV ).

I'm looking for an up to date card list in a downloadable format ( If it has the recent PDF sets event better ).

Apologies if it is available in this new site format, but I can't seem to find it.

Messages.Author: drnlmza
Messages.Body:
There's a "Card Lists" link in the Rules sidebar. It doesn't seem to have the full cardlist available, but instead breaks up the cards by letter, and also doesn't appear to have the PDF cards included.

The full text versiopn of the cardlist is available at www.vekn.net/images/stories/downloads/cardlist.txt - that is still missing the latest Anarchs Unbound expansion, but has the other PDF cards, including the storyline reward cards. I assume that the csv zip file is also available from the www.vekn.net/images/stories/downloads/ section, but I don't remember how the file was named, and that section of the site isn't browsable.

--
